'''John Sheffield''' (15 December 1936 – 22 July 2026) was a British physicist.

== Early life and career ==
Sheffield was born in [[London]] on 15 December 1936. He attended the [[Imperial College London]], earning his [[Bachelor of Science|BSc degree]] in 1958. He also attended the [[University of London]], earning his [[Master of Science|MSc degree]] in 1962 and his [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD degree]] in [[physics]] in 1966. After earning his degrees, he joined the Fusion Research Center at the [[University of Texas at Austin]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.legacy.com/us/obituaries/name/dr-john-sheffield-obituary?id=62126588|title=Dr. John Sheffield|work=Legacy|access-date=August 22, 2026|via=[[Legacy.com]]}}</ref>

In 1977, Sheffield joined the fusion division of the [[Oak Ridge National Laboratory]] (ORNL), a [[federally funded research and development centers|federally funded research and development center]] in [[Oak Ridge, Tennessee]].<ref name="b" /> During his time at ORNL, in 1981, he was named a [[Lists of fellows of the American Physical Society|fellow]] of the [[American Physical Society]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.aps.org/funding-recognition/aps-fellowship?q=John%20Sheffield&af=true|title=APS Fellow Archive|work=[[American Physical Society]]|access-date=August 22, 2026}}</ref> and from 1988 to 1994, he served as division head. He also served as director for [[energy]] programs,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.seas.ucla.edu/cestar/colloquia/Sheffield_Bio.pdf|title=John Sheffield's Brief Bio|work=Seasucla.edu|access-date=22 August 2026}}</ref> and was executive director of the Joint Institute for Energy and Environment until 2003.<ref name="b">{{Cite web|url=https://www.dignitymemorial.com/obituaries/roswell-ga/john-sheffield-12978650|title=John Sheffield|work=Dignity Memorial|access-date=August 22, 2026}}</ref>

== Personal life and death ==
Sheffield was married to Sharon Curfman. Their marriage lasted until Sheffield's death in 2026.<ref name="a">{{Cite web|url=https://www.oakridger.com/obituaries/pokr1538525|title=Dr. John Sheffield|work=[[The Oak Ridger]]|date=August 8, 2026|access-date=August 22, 2026}}</ref> He died on 22 July 2026, at the age of 89.<ref name="a" />
